say:1:1035224001:1.text: Our daughter, Lea, went to pick some scarlet pome but hasn't returned.
say:1:1035224001:1.source_cn: 我们的女儿莱雅出去采蜜果了，一直没有回来。
say:1:1035224001:1.male: Our daughter, Lea, went to pick some scarlet pome but hasn't returned.
say:1:1035224001:1.female: Our daughter, Lea, went to pick some scarlet pome but hasn't returned.

say:2:1035224002:1.text: I'm a bit worried about her.
say:2:1035224002:1.male: I'm a bit worried about her.
say:2:1035224002:1.female: I'm a bit worried about her.

say:3:1035224003:1.text: It's my husband's fault! Had to clamor on about wanting fruit!
say:3:1035224003:1.source_cn: 都怪这老头子，这么危险的情况，非说想吃果子！
say:3:1035224003:1.male: It's my husband's fault! Had to clamor on about wanting fruit!
say:3:1035224003:1.female: It's my husband's fault! Had to clamor on about wanting fruit!

say:4:1035224004:1.text: It's dangerous out there... what would I do if something happened to her?!
say:4:1035224004:1.source_cn: 这下好了，万一莱雅要是有什么三长两短，让我怎么活啊？！
say:4:1035224004:1.male: It's dangerous out there... what would I do if something happened to her?!
say:4:1035224004:1.female: It's dangerous out there... what would I do if something happened to her?!

say:6:1035224005:1.text: Thank you for your kind words, but I think I'll wait for her here.
say:6:1035224005:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的安慰。不过，我还是在这里等等她吧。
